Verify exact whole-request score/PV/nodes/completion parity with ordinary table and no observer, including aborted work. Native JVM lifetime CPU and peak working set recorded. Different completed depths/caps remain visible; no equal-work speed claim when trees differ.
analysis: Report per-profile total and paired cost ratios, completion/cap distribution, move/score changes and baseline mechanism incidence. Retain adverse root witnesses. Compare only matched completed requests for target-depth economics, while also reporting every capped request. No Elo inference, no selective exclusions, no runtime tuning during this frozen stage.
nextSelection: Prioritize substantial repeatable effects, unexpectedly sparse mechanisms, adverse witnesses or strong mechanistic overlap. A promising removal requires quality evidence and fresh independent clock confirmation before recommendation. Marginal noisy timing alone does not admit a tournament. No forced winner or exhaustive parameter sweep. New stages need separate frozen protocols.
